name: Context7
summary: Docs for the library version you use.
description: Context7 resolves a library and version to its documentation and returns relevant excerpts. It works without an account; a key raises the rate limit. This is the cheapest fix for an agent that writes an API that no longer exists.

probe.note: Answered initialize without credentials and listed 2 tools; the vendor documents a key that raises limits or unlocks account tools, sent in the Authorization header.
